newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Marxists warn may dump govt over sell-offs.
newsitem.headline: Italy Marxists warn may dump govt over sell-offs.

text.p: The hardleft Communist Refoundation party would be willing to withdraw support for the government if Prime Minister Romano Prodi pushes ahead with privatisations in key sectors, a senior party official said.
Refoundation's economic spokesman Nerio Nesi said his party was against the sale of telecom group Stet, energy firm ENI and electricity utility Enel.
"We are ready to leave the (government) over this," Nesi told reporters at a book presentation.
Communist Refoundation lies outside Prodi's centre-left coalition, but guarantees the government's majority in the lower house of parliament.
"We hope we have the force to make people think carefully about the (sell-offs)," Nesi said, adding that Refoundation was not opposed to all privatisations, just those in key strategic sectors.

Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Saturday he intended to forge ahead with Italy's privatisation programme, with Stet slated for sale in the autumn. A third tranche of Eni is also expected to be placed on the market this year, while discussions about the Enel sell-off are underway.
